qname.description: Name of the guest, displayed in VNC/SDL windows and used for identification.

uuid.description: System UUID for the guest. Must be a valid UUID string.

machine_type.description: The emulated PowerPC machine type. Common options: mac99 (Power Mac G3), prep (PReP), g3beige, ibm_termserver.

accel.description: Acceleration engine to use. Options: kvm (Linux), xen, hvf (macOS), nvmm (NetBSD), whpx (Windows), tcg.

cpu_model.description: CPU model to emulate. Use '-cpu help' for available models for the selected machine.

smp_config.description: SMP configuration string. Format: cpus[,sockets=...][,cores=...][,threads=...]. Product must equal cpus.

memory.description: Guest RAM size. Supports suffixes M, G. Example: 1G, 256M.

disk_image.description: Path to the primary disk image file. If the filename contains commas, they must be doubled in the values.

cdrom_image.description: Path to the CD-ROM image file. If null or empty string, no CD-ROM drive is configured.

network_backend.description: Network backend type. Supported in template: 'user' (NAT), 'tap' (TAP interface). Others require manual config.

network_model.description: Network device model to use. Common options: ne2k_pci, rtl8139, virtio-net-pci (if supported by machine).

mac_address.description: MAC address for the virtual network interface.

display_type.description: Display backend. Options: gtk, sdl, curses, spice-app, vnc, none, cocoa (Mac).

vnc_display.description: VNC display number or socket path, used when display_type is 'vnc'. Example: ':0' or 'localhost:5900'.

spice_port.description: SPICE port number, used when display_type is 'spice'.

serial_output.description: Serial port backend. Options: vc, pty, none, stdio, tcp:..., udp:....

boot_order.description: Boot order string. Drive letters: a (floppy), c (hard disk), d (CD-ROM), n (network).

prom_envs.description: List of OpenBIOS NVRAM environment variables to set. Format: 'variable=value'. Example: ['auto-boot?=false', 'boot-device=hd:2,\yaboot'].

kernel_image.description: Path to a kernel image (bzImage, zImage) for direct boot. If null, BIOS bootloader is used.

initrd_image.description: Path to an initial ramdisk image (initrd). Used with -kernel.

kernel_cmdline.description: Kernel command line arguments. Used with -kernel.

extra_args.description: List of additional command-line arguments not covered by other variables. Example: ['-no-reboot', '-S'].
